notes: Amcrest is a Dahua OEM (confirmed by Amcrest's own RTSP KB article using the Dahua /cam/realmonitor path). subtype=0 = main stream, subtype=1 = sub stream, subtype=2 = third stream (when supported). channel=1 for standalone IP cameras; for NVRs channel indexes per-camera (1–N). Authentication is passed in the URL as rtsp://{user}:{pass}@{ip}:{port}/... Some Smart Home product docs append &authbasic=64 but the core path is identical. Default port 554. Exception: the Helix (HLX-) line, Amcrest’s NDAA-compliant range, uses a different format, rtsp://{user}:{pass}@{ip}:554/<channel>/<stream>, with stream 1 = main and 0 = sub (Amcrest KB ‘Accessing Legacy Helix Devices Using RTSP’).
